title: Integral constructible Hom continuity in section modules
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $X$ be quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Pull the actual condensed ring of integers $\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ back to $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Use its reconstructed commutative section-ring sheaf $R$ and the exact equivalence between internal modules and section modules [lem-sfb-module-object-ringed-site-derived-comparison]. Let $K\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] have bounded general-ring-object constructible cohomology after the inverse equivalence [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Then $K$ satisfies $\mathrm{HasLocalizationHomContinuity}$ [def-sfb-localization-hom-comparison-data]: for every sequential diagram $N$ of complexes with one common termwise lower bound, the canonical map $Q(\operatorname{colimit.post}(N,\Gamma_K))$ is invertible, where $\Gamma_K$ is the fixed functorial K-injective internal-Hom model. No constructibility or completeness condition is required of $N$.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2, Lemma 6.8.12 and Proposition 6.8.14(2); agent extraction of the coefficient and exact-equivalence transport.

proof.text: General-lfp and finite constant-model constructibility agree for the actual integral coefficient ring. The integral coefficient comparison identifies it with the continuous ring defined using the spectral extension absolute value on ULift E. Restriction along the inverse coefficient isomorphism transports boundedness and all cohomology local models.

Apply bounded finite-model generation and the proved closed-support and open-immersion continuity lemmas, the integral case of constructible internal-Hom continuity, for the spectral extension coefficient. The exact section-module equivalence transports the cohomology cocones.

The coefficient-isomorphism scalar-Hom adjunction identifies Hom after restriction, and equivalence invariance transfers continuity to the actual section coefficient. A lifted sequential index fits the module universe; the cofinality comparison and cohomology criterion give the stated canonical quasi-isomorphism.

theorem integralSectionHomContinuity
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [(Scheme.ProEt.topology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarModules.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (ModuleObjectRingedComparison.ring (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) X)))
    (hK : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) X)
      (((ModuleObjectRingedComparison.equivalence
        (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) X).inverse.mapDerivedCategory).obj K)) :
    HasLocalizationHomContinuity.{u + 1, u, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (ModuleObjectRingedComparison.ring (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) X) K
